title: Fractional DAG treewidth controls DAG treewidth: profile reorientation and VC-dimension rounding
summary: For a nonempty finite graph, let \(F\) be its fractional DAG treewidth, maximized over all acyclic orientations. Its DAG treewidth is at most \(160F^3\ln(16F)\). This answers the boundedness question of Bressan, Lanzinger, and Roth. Reorienting the graph converts shattered source profiles into projective-plane obstructions, which bound their VC dimension by \(5F^2\). Classical epsilon-net rounding then converts fractional bag covers to integral ones without changing the decomposition.
